protocol.title: PE beads · Exp 08 · Detector gain ladder on real beads
protocol.summary: Image one field of bright and dim beads at six HV settings to confirm that gain only maps signal onto the ADC, and choose the plate HV.

children.body: Gain multiplies signal and noise together; it buys ADC range, not SNR.
Pins: that the integrated metric in photoelectrons does not depend on HV until clipping, that bead-to-bead CV does not improve with HV, and the HV for a plate.
Model: with a 16-bit ADC, clipping starts at gain ≈20 DN/e⁻ for 3,000 PE/µm² beads and ≈200 DN/e⁻ for 300 PE/µm². In 12-bit mode every threshold is 16× lower.

rows.free_text: Mixed beads: top-standard and low-standard assay beads in one well (or one high-coverage well)

rows.value: 6 values, from low to just clipping the brightest rim
Low → high → low (repeat the lowest at the end to catch bleaching)

children.body: Before any quantitative acquisition: stand and lasers on for 2–3 h; 561 nm excitation; the same PE emission band (e.g. 570–620 nm) every time; 16-bit with fine integration (the default is 12-bit, so check the file); one HV and one offset for the whole session; background mode at least 50 DN above zero; no saturated pixels. Record the transmitted-light channel with every PE frame: beads are found in it, never in PE. Find focus in transmitted light and hold it with Perfect Focus. Never live-scan PE to focus.
The brightest rim holds [!var:rim_e]; multiply the gain by [!var:gain_factor] to put it at [!var:target_frac] of full scale. Use the Exp 02 slope-against-HV fit to find that HV.
Find a field with both bright and dim beads, focus by transmitted light, hold with Perfect Focus.
Acquire the same field at 6 HV values, low → high, then the lowest again.
Convert each image to photoelectrons with the Exp 02 slope for its HV; compute the integrated metric per bead.
Plot integrated photoelectrons and bead-to-bead CV against HV. Both should be flat until rim pixels clip.
The last-minus-first low-HV image gives the bleaching the ladder caused.
Decision: one HV for a whole plate, set on the top standard with its brightest rim pixel at ≈70 % of full scale and inside the linear range found in Exp 02. Never auto-adjust gain.

Save the .nd2 files as acquired (no 8-bit export, no LUT) in a folder outside the website repo, e.g. BeadConfocalData/<date>_<exp>/, and fill one plate-map CSV row per well or field (columns are listed in Research/PE_bead_confocal_experiments.md, section 7).
